args.body: Thanks for letting us know about the washing machine, and for offering to replace it. As the machine came with the flat, we need to check with the landlord first, including that a replacement would stay your property and go with you when you leave. We've asked them and will update you as soon as we hear. This is a routine job, so our target is to get it sorted within 14 days. Please don't dispose of the old machine yet. If you can, send a photo of it and any error code on the display.

tickets.description:
Request summary with context: The Willow Maintenance washing machine is experiencing a power failure and is not operational.

Tenant's original query: Washing machine broken, it’s LG , we have googled it, it has power failure and can’t be fixed, I am willing to replace, this one was here when I moved in, but if I replace it will be mine and not become part of the property, if I ever was to move out I would take it with me.
